basis: Measured v5 allocated worker duration, scaled per modality by total exact-reference decisions; multiply by max(1,current reference-envelope seconds per call / historical forced-output seconds per call) and 1.25 safety factor.
limitation: Assumes v5 termination/output-length behaviour remains a usable workload proxy on larger tasks. This does not guarantee full completion at all maximum allowances; the original 56-GPU-hour branch cap governs, and every missing binding must be reported if it is exhausted.
reason: The maximum-call/full-384-output projection is not feasible in 56 GPU-hours. The unchanged full panel has a separate measured historical-consumption estimate; no easier tasks, smaller matrix, score-selected reruns or additional allocation are introduced.
